comments.t: I have noticed your lashes lately.  I have definitely lost a lot of lash volume over the last few years for various reasons.  Age (42) major weight loss (96 lb, lost a bunch of my hair too), radical hysterectomy (had endometriosis). I ordered one, it's worth a try. Next step is at home lash extensions. Thanks for the tip, hope it works! 💜

Crap!! I’m using Revitalash! I let my lash extensions fall out and whoa! My lashes were so short. I looked sick. I was horrified when I saw my natural lashes. I literally cried. And I had pretty long lashes before my extensions. I did love last extensions but they were getting pricy so I let them go. So I immediately ordered Revitalash from Leah’s company skin beautiful rx. And man, my lashes are so long. It took about a month for me to notice and 4 month in, holy moly, they are so long. And I get so many compliments!!

Thanks for the honest review.  I've been using rapid lash for many years. It too takes months for it to work, but I wouldn't say I like that it burns sometimes.  So if this is better, I'll try it since the price is comparable.
If you look really closely at the model for this lash serum, the lashes have cluster lashes on them. I hope this helps you girlies.

Hi Sheri! I love watching your videos as you are so honest and down to earth. I have a question about this lash serum. I'm a senior citizen that has had chemo twice and radiation once. My lashes grew back but not to what they used to be. So am I too old for a lash serum like this to work? I don't know if your hair follicles die off at a certain age but I sure hope not. Would you recommend I try this Dermelect lash serum or won't it do any good for me?
I was afraid to watch this video lest I spend more money!  🙂

As someone who woke up one morning to a very scary eye emergency, it's serious y'all. Just be happy with what you have. Your vision and eye health is not worth it. Swelling inside the eye is nothing to play with.

I've started using pure castor oil about 2 months ago. It wasn't a dramatic change but over time I've noticed that my lashes definitely seem thicker and more moisturised, so overall, I'm pretty happy and will continue to use it. No irritation or negative side effects in my case.

I have been using revitalash for 2 years no side effects.  My lashes are crazy long!Prior to that castor oil and vegamour both did nothing for my lashes.  I guess I would feel better if we had an ophthalmologist that wasn’t selling a product on this video. Not saying I don’t believe her but $52 for castor oil is expensive.

$52 for a small tube of castor, coconut, and argan oil is insane. I understand the science behind it but the price is outrageous. I'm someone who has been using castor oil with olive, coconut, and argan oil on my hair, lashes, and eyebrows for years and the effects are very noticeable. Nothing can explain the $52 for 0.33 oz of oils.

Thank you SO much for this show. I had seen weird effects from some of the ill effects of the over the counter lash boosters, plus the packaging talks about darkening of the lid. Now to hear the science behind these dark circles I'm so glad I threw it all away before more damage was done. Shame on the industry for allowing these for sale. Thank you, thank you, thank you,
As someone who suffers from severe dry eye this was an “eye opener “ .  One of the best videos on this topic!  I will be checking out her product and stop using Grande Lash or Latisse
As someone with blepharitis, I’ve always been afraid to use anything on my eye lids do this is so helpful!!! 💜🙏🏽

I have glaucoma and used these medication s for years. Yes, U had beautiful long lashes, but also noticed some of f these side effects. The skin rimming my eyes was always red and I had the sunken eye effect. The color change was more a problem for blue or green eyes. My eyes are brown, so not an issue for me. Ultimately, I needed surgery because the meds failed to stop the progression of the disease. Since then,  I have not needed the drops. The sunken eye and red eye symptoms did reverse. Those were the symptoms that were visible to me I do now have dry eye, but the surgery is probably the cause of that .
Wow. This all makes so much more sense. My eye has been infected every other week and I couldn’t figure it out. This makes a lot of sense now that’s it’s probably the eye serum I was using.

Before I was done watching this, I sent the link to my sister and a friend. I sent a second email apologizing for sending them a commercial.... I have been using one of the products the Dr. said was dangerous (Babe Lash) for about 4 years. No side effects, long lashes.

So I used to try lash growth serum. They made my eye lids super red to wear I HAD to wear concealer. My lashes would go through these intense cycles where I’d have nice long lashes then they would fall out and look awful for a few weeks. I just use castor oil now and I’m happy with the results.
I work in the beauty field and have received about 5 or 6 free. I am so glad I havent even started using any of them.

I used a lash serum 10 years ago that changed my eye color. I had blue eyes and started to notice that they were changing to a greenish hue with some darker flecks. Crazy that these products are allowed to be sold with ramifications.

As a result of watching this video, I decided to try the TwentyTwenty lash serum  which the the ophthalmologist is selling.  I’ve been using it nightly since mid-May 2023 and it is now early August.  So my conclusion is that it definitely helps with dry eye but I have seen no increase in eyelash length or thickness.  Since I am 70 yo, and my hair growth has slowed down generally, this could be why.  However, I am quite happy with the dry eye relief results.  I was using lubricating eye drops 3-4X per day and now find I rarely have to use them.  It feels like a soothing, natural way to treat this problem.  I tried applying in the morning as well but found it leaves a slight film over the eye so kind of hard to see clearly.  Haven’t decided whether to continue with the product or not at this point.  Of course I was hoping for lush, thick lashes but that’s obviously not happening.
